messages:
lucy: FYI Helios Health sent an RFI this morning, deadline EOD Thu. They want a completed security questionnaire + a capability matrix and a proposed POC plan. Can anyone help pull answers and confirm pricing for a 2-week dedicated POC?

omar: I can take the technical matrix and POC runbook. Need to know expected QPS and whether they require private (VPC) or hosted. lucy: they said sensitive PHI, so VPC + customer-managed KMS preferred.

ben: Pricing quick note — 2-week Dedicated POC (reserved GPU slice) we usually quote: $8k/week for a small pool (2xA100 equiv), or $20k/week for higher throughput pool with burst. We can offer a one-time POC discount (50% off) if they sign MSA within 30 days. Want me to draft numbers?

lucy: yes please @ben, include optional hosted fallback pricing (pay-as-you-go) and a note about data residency costs. Also they asked about SLA during the POC.

ben: Drafted numbers: Dedicated POC: $8k/wk (small), $20k/wk (high). Hosted fallback: $0.12/token gen + $0.0008/embed (example). SLA: internal SLOs apply, we can offer 99% uptime target for dedicated POC but not enterprise SLA until contract signed. Will add to reply doc.

sasha: I'll handle the security questionnaire sections around encryption, logging, and access controls. Quick asks: do we have HSM/KMS flow diagram for Private? Also need confirmation on SOC2 / ISO27001 status to reference.

lucy: they requested HSM-backed key management for customer keys and audit logs forwarded to their Splunk.

sec-bot: Vulnerability scan for latest onprem package completed. Summary: no critical issues; two medium findings (dependency updates). Full report: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/sec/reports/scan-2419876520.pdf

sasha: thanks @sec-bot. I'll attach SOC2 cert and the scan link. For HSM, we can say: supports customer-managed KMS (Cloud KMS/HSM integrations) and onprem HSM via PKCS#11 in Private deployment. Will include the flow diagram. Need product to confirm exact connector names. @omar can you paste the diagram or repo link?

omar: diagram in repo: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/hsm-diagrams -> file helio-integration.png. I'll export a PNG and add to drive. Also will outline network peering steps and a minimal firewall policy for POC.

riya: I'll assemble the capability matrix spreadsheet and attach the completed RFI bundle to the shared drive. Path: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HeliosRFI-Redwood (I will add access for Helios and legal). Who will review answers before send?

lucy: I'll do a final read and then legal will sign off. Can we aim to have first draft by tomorrow EOD?

ben: I'll upload the pricing worksheet to the drive now.

omar: Technical matrix notes I'll include: model catalog compatibility, latency SLOs per model variant, KV cache + prefix caching support, quantization profiles we recommend for POC, expected throughput numbers for 2xA100 equiv.

sasha: Security notes I'll add: encryption at rest (AES-256), in-transit (TLS1.3), customer-managed KMS options, HSM integration, audit logging, SOC2/ISO cert refs, data retention policy options, and support for egress controls.

lucy: Helios also asked about telemetry during POC — can we provide request-level latency + token-cost dashboards?

omar: yes, via Console. We can add a per-route dashboard sample and a sample JSON export of traces. I'll attach screenshots.

riya: Action items agreed: @omar technical matrix + diagrams (due tomorrow 5pm), @sasha sec questionnaire answers + attachments (tomorrow 5pm), @ben pricing worksheet + optional discount clause (tomorrow noon), @lucy final review & submit (Thursday 10am).

lucy: perfect. quick Q — for the POC contract we should include a rollback/fallback policy to hosted if Private integration hits blockers. Ben, add a fallback fee line?

ben: yes, add a 'fallback to hosted' option: $2k setup + pay-as-you-go execution for the remainder of POC. I'll include terms.

lucy: thanks team. I'll DM legal to expedite sign-off. attaching initial ask from Helios as a screenshot in the drive.

sec-bot: Reminder: Compliance pack template (SOC2 + ISO) available at https://vault.redwood.corp/compliance/packs/standard.zip

omar: I'll start drafting the POC test plan: acceptance criteria, sample prompt suite, data handling checklist. Will paste test prompts here when ready.

lucy: awesome. ping me when uploads done and I'll invite Helios to the drive. :thumbsup:
